name: auth-restaurant-context-login-race
title: Keep restaurant context loading after rapid account switch
description: Prevent an Apollo cache reset started by logout from cancelling the authenticated business-context query of the next login.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: Backend restaurant scope remains authoritative through active BrandMembership and scopedRestaurants. CI passed conflict checks, lint, unit tests, changed component tests, backend tests, and frontend/backend builds. The repository smoke suite still failed at its existing Playwright smoke step, matching an unrelated concurrent PR run.
